<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed" xml:id="ex5032023-05-2516-45-33">mnyam pa nyid sgom pas mi slob par ci ltar 'gyur zhe na|_bslab par bya ba ni zhes gsungs te|_'di gnyis la blang dor med par mnyam pa'i de kho na dang des kyang gnyis ka la mi gnas par slob pas rang dang [- 298 -]gzhan gyi don rdzogs par byed pa'i shes rab chen po dang snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs shing mthar phyin pa chos sku thob pa ni bya ba thams cad byas pa yin pa'i phyir ro|_|zhes dgongs pa'o|_|rtsa _bar sbyar ba ni de'i phyir chos rnams zhes so|_|bye brag tu bshad pa ni 'di phan chad nas te 'di'i nus pa'i yul de thob nas ni de gnyis kyi rnam rtog spang ba rdzogs pas te thob pa'i rgyud de kho nar mnyam pa sgom pa'o|_|rnam par rtog pa med pa ni tha dad med pas mnyam pa'i don to|_|las med pa'i klan ka spang ba la drug las|_klan ka dgod pa ni de skad ces nas te thams cad rmi lam dang mnyam na rmi lam bzhin du nyes legs kyi lam las 'phel 'grib _yod dam ste med _par _thal _lo _zhes _bsams _pa'o|_|rmi lam gyi mtshan nyid can yin gyi phyogs gcig nas 'dra ba tsam min pas don dam par 'dod pa nyid kyi lan ni rab 'byor _gyis nas so|_|
            
            tha snyad du las dman pa yod pa'i phyir|_dpe ma _grub _pas _de _spong ba ni shA ri'i bus smras pa 'di khri na bzhugs pa gzigs nas 'dir dgos pa gcig 'dug gsung
                  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsA chen po</rs>s nyid kyi dpe la bcug zhes shA ri'i bus smras pa 'on te sad nas zhes te rmi lam nyid kyi la yang sbyor ba dang rjes la sogs pa ci rigs pa'i las kyi lam yod pas so ||</seg></TEI>
